definition.name: Refund policy finder
definition.description: Finds a shop's refund policy page and sums up its terms.
definition.instructions:
Find the shop's refund policy page, then sum up its return window and who pays for return shipping, in a few lines.

Learn on taylorstitch: [["shopify-refund-policy-path.md","---
name: Shopify refund policy path
description: On a Shopify store the refund policy is at /policies/refund-policy
type: reference
---
Shopify stores serve their refund policy at `/policies/refund-policy`.

`/pages/returns` and `/pages/refund-policy` were empty on Taylor Stitch: they hold a returns portal, not the policy.
"]]
Learn on brooklinen: [["try-policies-refund-policy-first.md","---
name: Try /policies/refund-policy first
description: Open /policies/refund-policy before any other page; fall back to /pages/returns
type: feedback
supersedes: [shopify-refund-policy-path.md]
---
Open `https://<shop>/policies/refund-policy` first. It answered at once on Taylor Stitch and Brooklinen.

**Why:** most of these shops run on Shopify, which always serves that path.

**How to apply:** fetch it before any search. Only if it's a 404, try `/pages/returns`, then the links in the site's footer.
"]]
Learn on kith: [["kith-returns-portal.md","---
name: Kith returns go through a portal
description: Kith's returns start at returns.kith.com, not on the policy page
type: project
---
Kith sends returns through its own portal at returns.kith.com.
"]]
Drop: kith-returns-portal.md: It's about one shop's returns portal, not a rule other shops share.
